firstLines: This pack tests judgment through bounded text decisions, not live tool execution or mechanical helpers. It has three composite cases; five fresh runs per case and variant, one active test agent at a time. `control` has no tested workflow guidance; `baseline` receives verbatim installed 6.0 excerpts, recorded by full and excerpt SHA-256 in `source-manifest.json`. Excerpt applicability is limited to the role being simulated.

Common harness system/developer context and catalog are present in both arms. These are fresh-context instruction-ablation trials, not blank-system model trials. Case facts are deliberately concrete and pressure combines deadline, sunk-cost/team expectations, and authority. No rubric is shown to children.

Run messages are preserved in `*-prompt.txt` (exact spawn payload); scenario and guidance file contents form its referenced prompt input. Raw final responses go in `*-response.txt`. Agent IDs/model/effort and manual scores are recorded separately. No claims about process safety or schema/helper behavior can be inferred from these responses.

Format integer cents as dollars with two decimal places; retain negative signs including amounts between -99 and -1 cents. reproduce.mjs generates source and build output in its working tree. OUT_DIR chooses build output; TMPDIR chooses temporary output.
# Workflow reliability across interruptions and retries

Runs preserve work and evidence across interruptions, denied operations, and retries, and accurately report what remains before acceptance. Repairs address the confirmed failure mechanisms without adding a new workflow engine or expanding routine agent ceremony.
